name: DRD Migrate
description: Import a legacy DRD 7 site inventory into this DRD dashboard.
project_description: Submodule of Drupal Remote Dashboard (DRD). Provides a one-shot importer that reads a JSON inventory exported from a legacy DRD 7 dashboard and recreates the corresponding drd_core and drd_domain entities in this DRD dashboard, pushing each site's one-time token to its DRD Agent so the connection is re-established. Exposed as a single Drush command (drd:migratefromd7). The module's .info.yml description is a placeholder ('TODO'); this describes its actual behaviour from source. Requires the DRD base module.
